description.en: Import GitHub issues into a local board.
description.zh-TW: 將 GitHub Issues 匯入本機看板。

description.en: Repository to import, in owner/name format, for example octocat/Hello-World. Pull requests are excluded.
description.zh-TW: 要匯入的儲存庫，格式為 owner/name，例如 octocat/Hello-World。匯入時不包含 Pull Request。

description.en: Destination column for open issues. Later syncs follow issue status changes unless you manually override the card.
description.zh-TW: 未結案 Issue 的匯入欄位。後續同步會依結案狀態移動卡片；手動調整過的卡片則保留你的設定。

description.en: Destination column for closed issues. Later syncs follow issue status changes unless you manually override the card.
description.zh-TW: 已結案 Issue 的匯入欄位。後續同步會依結案狀態移動卡片；手動調整過的卡片則保留你的設定。

description.en: Import GitHub issue labels as card labels. Enabled by default.
description.zh-TW: 將 GitHub Issue 的標籤匯入為卡片標籤，預設開啟。

description.en: GitHub access token with permission to read the repository. Optional for public repositories; required for private repositories. Stored by Cardbe and sent only to api.github.com.
description.zh-TW: 具備儲存庫讀取權限的 GitHub 存取權杖。公開儲存庫可留空，私人儲存庫必填。由 Cardbe 儲存，僅傳送至 api.github.com。

label.zh-TW: GitHub 權杖（公開儲存庫可留空）
